title: The Slow Tide
author: Kestrel Reyes
blurb: Ada Oyelaran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
